description: Use this when you need to project a 2D path onto a selected face. Insert `<shape>.projectCurve(...)` into a kernelCAD script. Closed mode wraps a path and returns a Sketch. Open mode (`as_edge: true`) takes an explicit `source_plane` and world-space `direction`, awaits the projection, and binds every resulting edge as a Curve3D array for downstream curve operations. The source is `{ kind: "sketchCommands", commands: [...] }`. Side-effect-free; returns modified code plus diagnostics.

as_edge.description: Open-wire projection. When true, commands must be open, source_plane and direction are required, and bind_as receives an awaited Curve3D[] result.

bind_as.description: Optional local variable name; emits a const binding (awaited when as_edge is true).

commands.description: 2D path as plain-number commands. Closed mode starts with moveTo and ends with close; open mode starts with moveTo, has one or more segments, and has no close.

direction.description: Required with as_edge:true. Non-zero world-space projection direction.

face.description: Target face — canonical name or label.

scale_mode.description: Closed projection Drawing.sketchOnFace scaling mode. Default original.

source_plane.description: Required with as_edge:true. Places the 2D source path in world space; origin is in mm and x_axis/normal define its frame.

target.description: Variable name of the Shape to chain onto.

name: project_curve
title: Project Curve
